question.text: Let N be the number of quadratic equations with coefficients from {0, 1, 2, ....., 9) such that 0 is a solution of each equation. Then the value of N is

solution.text:
$\begin{aligned}
& \text {Hint: } a x^2+b x+c=0 \\
& \text {one root is zero } \Rightarrow c=0 \\
& a \neq 0, a=1,2,3, \ldots 9 \\
& b=0, \ldots \ldots .9
\end{aligned}$
Number of value of $N=9 \times 10=90$
